fact: The Boletim Oficial of 19 February 2019 carries the text of Lei n.º 48/IX/2019, which sets the principles, norms and structure of the National Statistical System (SEN); the law is dated 19 February 2019, the document's published date.

Cabo Verde's INE board says it asserts its technical independence under the Lei de Bases do Sistema Estatistico Nacional (SEN), which the article treats as the law in force; the law's own date is not given, so the article's publication date is used.
system: Lei de Bases do Sistema Estatistico Nacional
